port.meaning: relative relief, NOT measured absolute bathymetry
port.interpretation: EXPLORATORY ONLY: empirical flat-bed calibration, no bathymetry validation
port.calibration: per-range median counts divided by flat-plane cosine, NOT measured gain/reflectivity
port.anchor: assumed zero at each nearest-nadir sample
port.units: conditional model metres; not verified physical elevation
port.shadow_mask: only automatic validity filtering; no manual shadow annotation
